description: 史蒂夫·科恩（Steve Cohen）领导的 Point72 继承了其前身 SAC Capital 的敏锐嗅觉，是多空策略（Long/Short Equity）的标杆。Point72 拥有极其专业的行业分工体系，通过深度基本面研究和大数据分析获取信息优势。科恩极其重视人才培养（Point72 学院）和技术赋能，追求稳健的风险调整后收益。

description_en: Point72, led by Steve Cohen, carries forward the sharp trading instincts of its predecessor SAC Capital and is a benchmark for long/short equity. Point72 has a highly specialized sector-research system and seeks informational advantages through deep fundamental work and data analysis. Cohen emphasizes talent development through Point72 Academy and technology-enabled investing.
